text:
Rep. John Gillette criticizes economic decisions and media conduct in August social posts
G. D. Crespo
Rep. John Gillette, a Republican representing Arizona's 30th House District since 2023, used his social media platform on August 12, 2026, to criticize recent economic and media developments in the state.
In one post from that day, Gillette questioned executive claims about reducing costs for taxpayers. He wrote: "Name the specific cost you personally lowered through executive action. Not a federal subsidy THAT COST TAX PAYERS not a legislative appropriation, not a bill passed by the Republican Legislature, and not a program that transfers taxpayer money. Did you lower gasoline tax,", (August 12, 2026).
Later the same day, Gillette addressed what he perceives as media bias in political coverage. He stated: "The mainstream media isn't dead, its working for the democrats. Not one of these so called journalist asked any questions, you're right they just let her babble on. We will use this.. I named this 'operation let her speak'. The Ads are coming.", (August 12, 2026).
In another post focused on state energy policy and its consequences for local communities and economies, Gillette commented: "Hobbs made a devastating economic decision, and now taxpayers are being asked to finance the cleanup. The closure of Navajo Generating Station, Mohave Generating Station, and the Kayenta Mine did not just shut down 'old energy.' It eliminated high-wage jobs, tribal revenue,", (August 12, 2026).
Gillette was elected to represent Arizona's 30th House District in 2023 after replacing former representative Christian Solorio.
